name: Equality
overview: Scripture affirms the equal worth of all people as created in God's image, male and female alike, emphasizing that no person is greater than another before God. This equality extends across social and ethnic boundaries, as believers are commanded to love their neighbors and not oppress strangers. The Bible clearly teaches that God shows no partiality, uniting the rich and poor under His sovereign hand and calling His followers to reflect this impartial love in their relationships.
